user.title: tHAsk
user.description: Set up tHAsk? A first list will be created.

add_task.name: Add task
add_task.description: Adds a task, optionally due on a day or within a week, month, quarter or year.

due_granularity.name: Due within
due_granularity.description: Precision of the due date. Without a date the current period is used (e.g. this week).

my_day.name: Add to My Day
my_day.description: Show the task in My Day today.

get_tasks.name: Get tasks
get_tasks.description: Returns tasks, e.g. everything due by the end of this week.

entity_id.name: List
entity_id.description: Only tasks of this list (empty = all).

import_ms_todo.name: Import from MS To Do
import_ms_todo.description: Imports a file created with tools/ms_todo_export.py. Tasks imported before are skipped. Admins only.

file.name: File
file.description: Path relative to the config folder.

skip_flagged_emails.name: Skip flagged emails
skip_flagged_emails.description: Do not import the automatic flagged emails list.

convert_month_ends.name: Month end → whole month
convert_month_ends.description: Tasks due on the last day of a month become due within that month.

convert_sundays.name: Sunday → whole week
convert_sundays.description: Tasks due on a Sunday become due within that week.
